policies.title: Yemeni ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Yemen as requiring a visa prior to arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Yemeni passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada says the visa must be obtained at one of its missions or consulates before travel.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Yemeni ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Yemen in its authorized-visa cohort for advance immigration approval.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Yemeni passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Authorized-visa approval may take up to 60 business days and must be granted before travel.
The applicant must appear in person at the consulate; Washington-specific filing mechanics are not generalized to every consular district.

policies.title: Yemeni ordinary passports: Türkiye advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's Foreign Ministry requires a visa for Yemeni ordinary passport holders; its e-Visa route is only for specified holders of qualifying third-country documents.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Yemeni passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Official passports have a separate 30-day exemption and are excluded.
The conditional e-Visa route for holders of qualifying Schengen, United States, United Kingdom or Ireland documents is excluded from this ordinary-passport baseline.
